title: Dynamic mangos
description: Make jungle trees auctally grow mangos and other tropical fruit. Smelt mangos into suger and craft them into yellow dye.
body: Dynamic Mangos adds pickable mangos hanging from natural jungle leaves. Mangos can be harvested by right-clicking leaves or by breaking leaves, then eaten as food. They can also be composted for bonemeal, crafted into yellow dye, or smelted into sugar.
